result.note: Mostly market moves and forecasts; tested only the excise duty cut and India's oil import dependence.

questions.prompt: In March 2026, the Iran war that broke out on 28 February put pressure on India's economy. Consider the following statements:
items: The Centre cut excise duties on petrol and diesel by INR 10 per litre to help oil companies.
India imports about 60% of its oil requirement.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: The excise cut is correct, but India imports 85% of its oil, not about 60%. That dependence makes every escalation in West Asia a macro event for India, and the petroleum minister warned the cut would mean a huge hit to tax revenues.
questions.source: New Delhi cut excise duties on petrol and diesel by INR 10 per litre to help out oil companies.
